# Consecutive judge samples pair into blocks; the judge's intercept is used.
exec pairedtiming -format okc -bootstrap 0 profile.json
stdout '^ *0 *decode 1 *46 *2 *4000 *2e\+04 *1e\+04 *2.0000 *2.0000 *$'
stdout '^ *decode 1 .* 2.0000 *$'
stdout '^score 2.0000'

# Odd sample counts cannot form blocks.
! exec pairedtiming -format okc odd.json
stderr 'benchmark 0: 3 baseline and 3 candidate samples'

-- profile.json --
{"benchmarks": [{"case": {"load": "decode 1", "weight": 46},
  "baseline_runs_ns": [24000, 24000, 24000, 24000],
  "runs_ns": [14000, 14000, 14000, 14000],
  "replay_overhead": {"overhead_ns": 4000}}]}
-- odd.json --
{"benchmarks": [{"case": {"load": "d", "weight": 1},
